policy: A one-provider city page is publishable when it has sourced city-level fine-art decision value independent of the provider profile, stays art-only, and links antiques to the antique directory. Repeated provider facts and generic city prose do not qualify.

sourceEvidence.finding: The operator restored the standalone Art host. City pages must be art-only and useful enough to index.
